items.title: North Korean hackers blamed for stealing record $6.3B in Binance breach
items.summary: Hackers working for North Korea are suspected of hacking a Binance employee's laptop, which allowed the theft of billions in crypto.
items.creator: Zack Whittaker

items.title: Skip the small talk: Make game-changing connections at TechCrunch Founder Summit with Braindate
items.summary: At TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026, happening November 4 at SoWa Power Station in Boston, networking powered by Braindate is designed to make those conversations easier to find, whether they are in 1:1 or small-group on-site meetings. Register before the event starts to save up to $100 on your pass, plus get a second for free.
